```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from haversine import haversine, Unit

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
# setup connection variables to local sql db
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
# Load required table
county_df = pd.read_sql_table("us_counties", engine)
```

## Prepare Dataframes for merging

```{python}
county_lookup = county_df[["county_id", "centroid_lon", "centroid_lat"]].copy()
county_lookup_2 = county_df[["county_id", "centroid_lon", "centroid_lat"]].copy()

county_lookup_2 = county_lookup_2.rename(columns = {
    "county_id": "county_id_2",
    "centroid_lon": "centroid_lon_2",
    "centroid_lat": "centroid_lat_2"
})
```

## Cross-Join Dataframes

```{python}
lookup_df = county_lookup.merge(county_lookup_2, how="cross")
```

## Calculate Haversine Distance

```{python}
lookup_df["distance_miles"] = lookup_df.apply(
    lambda row: haversine(
        (row["centroid_lat"], row["centroid_lon"]),
        (row["centroid_lat_2"], row["centroid_lon_2"]),
        unit = Unit.MILES
    ),
    axis = 1
)
```


```{python}
lookup_df.to_sql(
    "county_distances_lookup",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",

)
```
